text:
Avery (marketing): we locked next-wed for the micro-workshop. need a concise runbook: reg page, zoom config, recording + captions, and post-event lead flow into HubSpot. 48h turnaround.
Sam (ops): can build the reg page shell. need final copy and form fields.
Priya (growth): i'll draft lean copy. primary objective: signups -> watch-on-demand. keep form minimal: email, company, role, consent checkbox.
Ben (content): suggest optional segmentation question: 'biggest latency or cost challenge' (short textbox). map to hubspot property.
Lia (events): Zoom checklist: cloud recording, separate audio files, auto-transcription and SRT export, waiting room on, join-before-host off. confirm licensed host.
Sam (ops): confirmed host account: company.zoom@redwood.com (licensed). Zoom settings i'll enforce: Record to cloud, separate audio files, auto-transcription enabled, waiting room enabled. i'll schedule and enable cloud recording.
Priya (growth): CTA experimentation: A: 'Reserve your spot — low-latency serving patterns' B: 'Hands-on micro-workshop: cut token costs' we A/B test in the reminder.
Avery (marketing): capture UTM params (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign) as hidden fields. push to HubSpot contact properties.
Sam (ops): Zap outline: New form submission -> filter consent == true -> create/update HubSpot contact (map fields) -> add to list MW-registrants-MAR -> Customer.io send welcome. Post to #marketing-notify with payload.
Ben (content): welcome email draft: 'Thanks — your spot is reserved. Add to calendar + brief pre-read attached.' subject 6-8 words. will post copy doc.
Lia (events): post-event edit plan: produce 3 assets: teaser (60s), highlights (3-4m), full session trim with chapters. owners: Ben does teaser+highlights, EditBot handles raw export+SRT merge. SLAs: teaser 48h, highlights 72h, full edited 5d.
EditBot: queued; raw export ETA 2h after meeting ends.
Priya (growth): segmentation & nurture: attendees -> attended property; registrants who didn't attend -> replay flow: 1-day follow-up + 2-week nurture. segments: attended, no-show-but-watched, registered-no-action.
Avery (marketing): tagging convention: source='micro-workshop-mar', medium=web, campaign=mw-march. set contact property 'redwood_event_source' and 'engagement_channel'.
Sam (ops): host day checklist: join 15m early, soundcheck, record a 5s slate at start, confirm cloud shows recording, use waiting room for external guests.
Priya (growth): reg page consent text: 'By registering you consent to event-related communications from Redwood Inference. Unsubscribe anytime.' include privacy policy link.
Ben (content): post-event CTA in emails: 'Request a follow-up consult' -> map to contact property followup_interest.
Lia (events): storing assets: where do raw + edited files go?
Sam (ops): upload raw + SRT to gs://redwood-events/mw-2026-mar/raw/ and edited to gs://redwood-events/mw-2026-mar/edited/. will share ACLs with Ben & Priya.
Avery (marketing): add tracking on replay watch page: fire event 'mw_replay_view' with email if known. set GA goal for replay conversions.
Priya (growth): i'll run 50/50 subject-line split on reminder emails. Ben will supply copy variants.
Ben (content): uploading teaser + variants to content folder shortly.
Avery (marketing): final owners: reg page & UTM - Priya; Zoom + recording - Sam; edits - Ben & EditBot; Zap & HubSpot - Sam+Priya; welcome + nurture copy - Ben+Priya; analytics - Avery.
Lia (events): i'll share run-of-show tomorrow AM. blockers?
Priya (growth): none. publishing copy now.
Ben (content): on track, will deliver teaser by EOD. :thumbsup:
Sam (ops): scheduling meeting now and will post invite link once done.
Avery (marketing): awesome, thanks team. follow-ups: @Sam confirm ACLs, @Ben deliver teaser by EOD, @Priya ensure reg page live 24h prior. :rocket:
